copy.curiosityHook: What connects this seemingly random prize getaway to the gang's prior brush with the undead?
copy.description: After winning an all-expense-paid tropical vacation, Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang arrive at a resort that looks disturbingly familiar. When zombies storm their hotel, an old nightmare resurfaces.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, mildly spooky, and fast-moving, it offers an easygoing animated watch built for family night.
copy.whyWatch: Clocking in at a breezy 80 minutes, it mixes playful comedy with lively cartoon suspense, delivering a comfortable, retro mystery tailored for low-stress family viewing.

allowedMaterial: Vacation prize setup and arrival at Zombie Island
Recognition of the island from a past mystery
Zombies attacking the hotel and interrupting the getaway
excludedMaterial: Culprit identities or motivations behind the contest
Third-act encounters and final fate of the island
